agent_explanation: Shrunk scenario: single body sliding off a platform (wall 8.8,9,6.3x0.4) falls and bounces on floor (e=0.2 loses ~88J at step 188), then travels right at vx~2.72 m/s toward the implicit right boundary (x=20). With dt=0.016455 (2-3 substeps near impact), the boundary collision never produces a rebound: vx stays 2.717 from step 188 onward, and the body drifts incrementally beyond the arena each step (overshoot -0.0007 at step 190, +0.044 at 191, +0.088 at 192, +0.133 at 193, +0.178 at 194) violating the 0.15 limit at step 194. Reducing dt to 0.005 restores correct boundary handling and eliminates the violation, indicating a dt/substep-dependent failure to detect/correct the right-wall collision.
